raw_record.summary: Manage Instagram Business and Creator accounts via the Instagram Graph API. Publish posts and carousels, retrieve media and insights, moderate comments, send DMs, and manage story content. Use this skill when users want to manage Instagram content, analyze engagement, or automate social media workflows.
